chapters.2.meaning: Tyre sends wood and a skilled worker. Solomon also orders foreign residents into forced labor.
chapters.8.meaning: Solomon assigns different work to different groups. Some people face forced labor while others become officers.
chapters.9.meaning: The queen tests Solomon with her own questions. She praises the wisdom she finds.
chapters.10.meaning: The people ask for less work. Rehoboam threatens more, and most tribes reject him.
chapters.11.meaning: Priests and Levites leave Jeroboam's kingdom. Their move helps strengthen Judah.
chapters.12.meaning: Rehoboam humbles himself after the warning. Judah survives the attack but loses its treasures.
chapters.16.meaning: Asa rejects correction and imprisons the seer. His anger also harms other people.
chapters.17.meaning: Teachers travel through Judah with God's law. The king supports learning as well as defense.
chapters.20.meaning: Judah gathers to pray before battle. Jehoshaphat's later shipping plan fails after another warning.
chapters.24.meaning: Joash benefits from Jehoiada's care. He later orders the death of Jehoiada's son.
chapters.25.meaning: Amaziah brings home the defeated people's gods. He rejects a warning and later loses a war.
chapters.29.meaning: Priests and Levites clean the temple before worship returns. Repair requires shared work.
chapters.31.meaning: The people bring food for temple workers. The gifts also support the workers' families.
chapters.34.meaning: Huldah warns the king after the book is found. Josiah renews the people's promise to God.
chapters.19.meaning: Jehoshaphat appoints judges and warns them against bribes. Their decisions must serve justice.
chapters.33.meaning: Manasseh humbles himself and returns to Jerusalem. He removes worship objects he had earlier introduced.
chapters.36.meaning: Jerusalem falls, and people go into exile. Cyrus later permits a return to rebuild the temple.
people.david.meaning: His temple plans and God's promise to his family guide later kings.
people.hiram-artisan.meaning: His skill helps shape the temple's metalwork and other materials.
people.asaph-singer.meaning: Later singers follow the musical duties linked with his family.
people.pharaoh-daughter-solomon.meaning: Solomon builds a separate house for his Egyptian wife.
people.iddo-seer.meaning: The book names his writings among its records about Judah's earlier kings.
people.abihail-rehoboam.meaning: Her family connects Rehoboam's wife Mahalath with David's brother Eliab.
people.maacah-queen.meaning: Asa removes her royal position after she makes an object for worship.
people.shishak.meaning: Egypt's king attacks Judah and takes treasures from Jerusalem.
people.oded-azariah.meaning: The book names him as Azariah's father in the warning to Asa.
people.baasha.meaning: Israel's king builds Ramah to restrict movement into Judah. Asa seeks outside help against him.
people.joash-prince.meaning: Ahab orders Micaiah placed under his care and Amon's care until the king returns.
people.jahaziel.meaning: He speaks to the gathered people and encourages them before the battle.
people.eliezer-dodavahu.meaning: He warns Jehoshaphat about his partnership with Ahaziah. Their ships then break.
people.abraham.meaning: Jehoshaphat recalls God's gift of the land to Abraham's descendants while praying for help.
people.jehoram-judah.meaning: He kills his brothers after taking power. Revolts and attacks weaken his rule.
people.athaliah.meaning: She attacks the royal heirs and takes power. Joash's rescue leaves one heir alive.
people.hazael.meaning: His army attacks Judah during Joash's reign. Joash pays him to leave Jerusalem.
people.joash-nurse.meaning: She stays with Joash when Jehosheba hides him from Athaliah.
people.joash-judah.meaning: He repairs the temple under Jehoiada's care. Later, he orders the killing of Jehoiada's son.
people.mattan-baal.meaning: The people kill him when they destroy Baal's house.
people.joash-israel.meaning: Israel's king defeats Amaziah and breaks part of Jerusalem's wall.
people.amaziah-man-god.meaning: He warns Amaziah to send the hired Israelite soldiers home.
people.oded-samaria.meaning: He tells Israel's soldiers to release Judah's captives. He warns them against adding more guilt.
people.captive-care-leaders.meaning: They give captives clothes, food, drink, and care. They help weak people return on donkeys.
people.abi.meaning: Hezekiah's royal family record names her as his mother and Zechariah's daughter.
people.kore-imnah.meaning: He helps distribute gifts to temple workers and their families.
people.manasseh-king.meaning: He returns from captivity, removes false worship, and repairs God's altar.
people.hilkiah-priest.meaning: He finds the book of the law during temple repairs.
people.shallum-huldah.meaning: He keeps garments and belongs to the family named with the prophet Huldah.
people.maaseiah-josiah.meaning: This city officer helps carry out Josiah's plan to repair the temple.
people.jehoahaz-judah.meaning: Egypt's king removes him after three months and takes him to Egypt.
people.nebuchadnezzar.meaning: Babylon's king attacks Judah. His forces carry away people and treasure and destroy Jerusalem.
chapters.12.summary: Shishak takes Judah's defended towns and Jerusalem's treasures. Rehoboam humbles himself but later leaves God.
chapters.14.title: Asa changes worship and asks for help
chapters.17.summary: Jehoshaphat sends teachers through Judah with God's law. He also builds defenses and gathers soldiers.
chapters.26.summary: Uzziah builds towns, farms, and defenses. The priest Azariah stops his attempt to burn incense. Uzziah becomes ill.
chapters.34.title: Josiah changes worship and seeks Huldah's answer
chapters.26.meaning: Success makes Uzziah proud. His illness keeps him from temple worship. Jotham takes over daily rule.
chapters.36.summary: The final kings face Egypt and Babylon. Jerusalem and the temple fall. Cyrus allows a return to rebuild the temple.
people.jehoshaphat.role: King who supports teaching, judges, and prayer
people.josiah.meaning: He changes worship and renews Passover. He fights Neco, suffers wounds, and dies after returning to Jerusalem.
people.maaseiah-josiah.role: City officer helping repair the temple
people.cyrus.role: Persian king who permits a return
people.cyrus.relations: His order lets people go back to Jerusalem to rebuild the temple.
